title: How much context a writer needs
statement: How much context to give a writer, and when scope notes, source documents or curriculum blocks start to lower what it makes, is unsettled.
detail: An autopsy of document-based items found the arm that added generic curriculum notes to the real source documents did worse than the documents alone, and advised against layering such notes in until an A/B test showed no regression (`dbq_structural_zero.md`, line 136). A distilled report adds that, for dense courses, too many prompt examples can hurt (`ap_social_studies_generator_distilled.md`, line 186), while a generator kit lists scope boundaries injected at generation time as its fix for out-of-scope questions, in a design table rather than a measurement (the kit's `README.md`, line 139). To settle it: the A/B the autopsy asked for, on many more than six items, with and without each kind of context.
against: The worse result rests on six prompts (`build_PATH_G_dbq_hybrid.py`, line 4). Six items, one seed, one model (`feedback_d13_inference_injection_partial_fix_2026_05_12.md`, line 7). Measured against fresh outputs rather than stored ones, the richer context's overall effect on the continuous score was noise, +0.25 points (`feedback_baseline_must_be_fresh_gen.md`, line 36). Training with both blocks in the system message was reported safe (`feedback_d13_inference_injection_partial_fix_2026_05_12.md`, line 36).

evidence.quote: - DBQ route should prefer D13-only source grounding. Do not layer generic curriculum notes into the DBQ prompt until an A/B proves no regression; PATH G hybrid was worse than D13-only.
- For dense courses like APUSH, too many prompt examples can hurt; prefer exact facts/source packs over long example lists.
| Out-of-scope questions slip through | `assessment_boundaries` injected at gen time |

For SAQ (3 sub-questions, structured response): the verbose context confuses the response format. SAQ requires terse 2-3 sentence answers per sub-part; the boundaries text makes the model add disclaimers/scope notes that the grader doesn't reward.
**Rule (P0/T1; n=6 single-seed, single-model — promote to T0 after n≥30 replication):**
**Training-time (v52b+):** D13 + curriculum_context in system are PROVEN safe (v52b build pattern).
